name: Salesforce
description: Read and update Salesforce Contacts, Cases and any other sObject to keep CRM data in sync with automated conversations.

soql_query.label: Run SOQL Query
soql_query.description: Search Salesforce for Contacts, Cases or any records using a SOQL query.

query_more.label: Get More Results
query_more.description: Fetch the next page of a large query result.

list_sobjects.label: List Objects
list_sobjects.description: List the objects available in the Salesforce org, such as Contact and Case.

describe_sobject.label: Describe Object
describe_sobject.description: Show an object's fields, types and required values before reading or writing it.

get_record.label: Get Record
get_record.description: Get a single Salesforce record by object type and id.

create_record.label: Create Record
create_record.description: Create a new Salesforce record such as a Contact or Case.

update_record.label: Update Record
update_record.description: Update fields on an existing Salesforce record.

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.description: Your Salesforce My Domain URL, e.g. https://your-domain.my.salesforce.com (Setup → My Domain).

clientId.label: Consumer Key
clientId.description: The Connected App's Consumer Key (OAuth client_id) with the Client Credentials Flow enabled.

clientSecret.label: Consumer Secret
clientSecret.description: The Connected App's Consumer Secret (OAuth client_secret). Stored encrypted.
